data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's mediator model is outcome ~ checklist_score + understanding_residual, but the countercondition 'understanding operates entirely through the checklist' reveals the estimator is structurally biased toward zero for the very causal pathway it is meant to detect: by construction, any understanding effect realized through correct checklist application is absorbed into the checklist_score term, so the 'understanding path' can read near-zero even when understanding is the operative cause of reliability. This is collinearity/overcontrol, not evidence of mere compliance, so the test cannot distinguish 'panelist understanding drives reliable judgments' from 'no understanding path.'
